title_en: TikTok Shop Black Friday 2026 Runs Nov 11–30: Dates and Seller Rules
title_zh: TikTok Shop 2026 黑五网一 11 月 11–30 日：日期与卖家规则
desc_en: TikTok Shop's Black Friday and Cyber Monday campaign runs Nov 11–30, 2026. Last year's $500M+ weekend, official seller requirements and a checklist to prepare.
desc_zh: TikTok Shop 宣布 2026 年黑五网一活动将于 11 月 11 日至 30 日举行。本文梳理去年四天销售额超 5 亿美元的成绩、官方卖家报名门槛（店铺表现分、健康分、发货率）、延长退货期和备战清单。
body_en:
TikTok Shop's biggest sales event of the year now has dates. On October 19, 2026, TikTok Shop announced that its Black Friday and Cyber Monday campaign will run from November 11 to November 30, starting a day earlier than last year. With brands like Best Buy, Sephora and Ulta Beauty selling on the platform for their first holiday season, competition will be tougher. Here is what TikTok announced, the official seller requirements, and how to prepare.

What TikTok Shop announced

  • Dates. "Shop the Black Friday and Cyber Monday campaign on TikTok Shop, November 11 through November 30," according to TikTok Shop's release (via GlobeNewswire, Oct 19, 2026). Modern Retail (Oct 20) notes this starts a day earlier than in 2025.
  • Last year's results. TikTok says sales during the four-day 2025 Black Friday–Cyber Monday weekend topped $500 million, and sellers hosting livestreams saw 84% year-over-year sales growth across more than 760,000 sessions and 1.6 billion views.
  • More brands. TikTok says it has expanded product selection by more than 1,200% since 2024, and Sephora, Michael Kors, Best Buy, Ulta Beauty and Victoria's Secret joined this year.
  • Shopper perks. Eligible products can carry a "3-Day Delivery" badge, and eligible purchases can be returned at about 10,000 Happy Returns locations without a box or label.

Signals of holiday demand

TikTok Shop data shared with Modern Retail shows holiday content rising fast:

TikTok also says nearly one-third of US TikTok users expect to buy a gift on Black Friday, one in five expect to buy gaming devices or items, collectibles sales grew 230% year over year in October, and US LIVE Shopping sales more than doubled year over year in the first half of 2026. These are TikTok's own figures.

Official seller requirements

TikTok Shop's 2026 BFCM Seller Campaign Guide sets out the rules:

RequirementDetail
Shop Performance Score (SPS)3.5 or higher; newer shops without an SPS need fewer than 3 serious violations in the last 30 days. Below 3.0, campaign benefits may be revoked
Account Health Rating (AHR)Ideally above 150; at or below 150, campaign registration may be restricted
Late Dispatch Rate20% or lower over 30 days
Holiday ModeMust be turned off
RegistrationSeller Center › Marketing › Campaigns; most applications reviewed in 5–14 business days
ListingsCreate products at least 2 weeks before the campaign starts
ReturnsItems sold Nov 11 (4 p.m. PT) to Dec 31 can be returned until Feb 10, 2027
Dispatch time+1 business day for orders Nov 11–24, +2 for Nov 25–Dec 1, +1 for Dec 2–5 (domestic)

The guide also warns that many self-promotion tools, such as extra discounts or flash deals, do not stack on top of campaign pricing. For more on the account metrics, see our TikTok Shop Account Health Rating guide.

What it means for sellers (our analysis)

Register now, not in November. With reviews taking up to 14 business days and listings needed two weeks before the start, early November is already late.

Protect your scores. The SPS and dispatch thresholds decide whether you can join. Ship on time and keep cancellations low through October.

Plan for longer returns. Holiday purchases can be returned until February 10, 2027. Budget for returns in your campaign margins; our Happy Returns article explains the box-free option.

LIVE and creators drive results. TikTok's own numbers point to livestreams. Line up creators and LIVE sessions for the key days now.

Watch the competition. Bigger brands mean higher ad costs and more polished content. Smaller sellers should focus on clear offers and niche products.

Checklist

  1. Check SPS, AHR and Late Dispatch Rate today.
  2. Register shop and products in Seller Center › Marketing › Campaigns.
  3. Finalize campaign prices; don't count on stacking extra discounts.
  4. Book creators and schedule LIVE sessions for November 11–30.
  5. Stock inventory for the campaign and the extended return window.

How Atronia Innovations can help

We run TikTok Shop for brands and factories, including campaign registration, creator programs and LIVE planning. Talk to our team before the deadline.

Sources

  • Modern Retail — How brands are gearing up for TikTok Shop's biggest holiday season yet (Oct 20, 2026)
  • TikTok Shop Seller University — 2026 Black Friday & Cyber Monday Seller Campaign Guide
body_zh:
TikTok Shop 一年中最大的促销活动定档了。2026 年 10 月 19 日，TikTok Shop 宣布黑五网一活动将于 11 月 11 日至 11 月 30 日举行，比去年提前一天开始。今年是百思买、丝芙兰、Ulta Beauty 等品牌首次在平台上过假日季，竞争会更激烈。下面梳理 TikTok 的公告、官方卖家要求以及备战建议。

TikTok Shop 公布了什么

  • 日期。据 TikTok Shop 新闻稿（GlobeNewswire，2026 年 10 月 19 日），“11 月 11 日至 11 月 30 日在 TikTok Shop 参加黑五网一活动”。Modern Retail（10 月 20 日）指出比 2025 年提前一天开始。
  • 去年成绩。TikTok 称，2025 年黑五网一四天周末销售额超过 5 亿美元；开直播的卖家销售额同比增长 84%，共 76 万多场直播、16 亿次观看。
  • 品牌更多。TikTok 称自 2024 年以来商品品类扩充超过 1,200%，丝芙兰、Michael Kors、百思买、Ulta Beauty 和维多利亚的秘密今年入驻。
  • 购物者福利。符合条件的商品可带“3 日达”标识，符合条件的订单可在约 1 万个 Happy Returns 网点免纸箱、免面单退货。

节日需求信号

TikTok Shop 提供给 Modern Retail 的数据显示，节日相关内容快速增长：

TikTok 还称，近三分之一的美国用户预计在黑五买礼物，五分之一预计购买游戏设备或相关商品；收藏品类 10 月销售同比增长 230%；2026 年上半年美国直播带货销售同比翻倍以上。以上均为 TikTok 自有数据。

官方卖家要求

TikTok Shop 《2026 黑五网一卖家活动指南》的规定：

要求内容
店铺表现分（SPS）3.5 及以上；尚无评分的新店需近 30 天严重违规少于 3 次。低于 3.0 可能被取消活动权益
店铺健康分（AHR）最好高于 150；等于或低于 150 可能限制活动报名
延迟发货率近 30 天 20% 及以下
休假模式必须关闭
报名卖家中心 › 营销 › 活动；多数申请 5–14 个工作日审核完毕
商品活动开始前至少 2 周创建商品
退货11 月 11 日（太平洋时间 16:00）至 12 月 31 日售出的商品可退至 2027 年 2 月 10 日
发货时效11 月 11–24 日订单 +1 个工作日，11 月 25 日–12 月 1 日 +2 个，12 月 2–5 日 +1 个（美国境内）

指南还提醒，很多自主促销工具（如额外折扣、限时秒杀）不能与活动价叠加。账户指标详见我们的《TikTok Shop 店铺健康分指南》。

我们的解读

现在就报名，别等到 11 月。审核最长 14 个工作日，商品需提前两周创建，11 月初才动手已经晚了。

守住评分。SPS 和发货指标决定你能否参加。整个 10 月都要准时发货、控制取消率。

为更长的退货期做准备。节日订单可退到 2027 年 2 月 10 日，活动毛利要预留退货成本；免纸箱退货可参考我们的《Happy Returns 接入 TikTok Shop》。

直播和达人是增长引擎。TikTok 自己的数据都指向直播。现在就为关键日期约好达人、排好直播。

关注竞争。大品牌入场意味着广告成本更高、内容更精良。中小卖家应聚焦清晰的优惠和细分产品。

行动清单

  1. 今天就检查 SPS、AHR 和延迟发货率。
  2. 在卖家中心 › 营销 › 活动报名店铺和商品。
  3. 确定活动价，不要指望叠加额外折扣。
  4. 为 11 月 11–30 日预约达人、安排直播。
  5. 按活动期和延长退货期备足库存。

Atronia Innovations 能帮你什么

我们为品牌和工厂代运营 TikTok Shop，包括活动报名、达人合作和直播策划。截止前欢迎联系我们的团队。
